Edge.PostMortemContent:
You try to analyze what went wrong. Succeed, and your edge reserve refills by 1 point.

Either way, this failure's XP is forfeited — the moment you attempt the analysis, that XP is gone, whether you succeed or fail.

The mechanic is meant only for failures with a real, noticeable consequence. Check with your GM first that this fits — not every botched roll in the middle of the fray.

Combat.StanceRetake: Take the current stance again and clear defence penalties

StanceEffect.Open: No movement, no defence — the stance for everything that happens outside the fight.
StanceEffect.SimpleMove: Walk. A compromise between getting somewhere and not dying on the way.
StanceEffect.CarefulMove: Walk on a successful “Bewegung+Athletik” roll, otherwise crawl. Cover bonuses hold even while out of cover, and the character can stay hidden.
StanceEffect.FastMove: Sprint, with no regard for cover.
StanceEffect.InCover: Crawl. Cover bonuses hold, and the character can stay hidden.
StanceEffect.EnGarde: No movement. Gives up cover to answer attacks from every side and by every means.
StanceEffect.SuppressiveFire: No movement. Every enemy in the area is attacked at once, every attack after the first one Malusstufe dearer; standard attacks and “Spray and Pray” only. The first dodge turns the stance into “In Deckung”.
StanceEffect.Grappling: No movement, no defence. Only grappling rolls may be made.
StanceEffect.CatchBreath: No movement, no defence. If no new Wuchtschaden arrives before the stance ends, the character is back in balance.

Status.Title: Conditions

Effect.SharpLegs: Moves at a crawl only — in combat that means the “Vorsichtige Bewegung” stance alone.
Effect.SharpArms: Can no longer take any action that needs hands: every attack, plus climbing, operating devices and the like at the GM's discretion.
Effect.BluntCore: Can take no action but “Sich fangen” and no stance but “Offen”.
Effect.BluntLegs: Moves at a crawl or a walk only — in combat that rules out the “Schnelle Bewegung” stance.
Effect.BluntArms: Can hold nothing in hand and drops it.
Effect.Loaded: No sprint — walking and crawling remain.
Effect.Overloaded: Crawling only — walking and sprinting are gone.
Effect.ArmorTooHeavy: Every Beweglichkeit roll is one Malusstufe (−3) harder.
Effect.NoDodge: No defence — neither dodge nor parry.
Effect.NoDodgeParryLeft: No dodge — only the parry remains.

Armor.SvHint: Counts towards the sum of every worn piece — whole values for the base layer, quarter steps for addons. Below the total SV, every Agility roll takes one penalty step.

Armor.RwHint: Padding. Feeds into Resistance = Strength + RW − Damage.
Armor.RwStackedHint: Added up: the Unterkleidung and the armour piece both contribute their RW — the number shown is the sum, not any one piece's value.
Armor.RwFromSuitHint: No armour piece on this location — the RW comes from the Unterkleidung alone.
Armor.RwSuitAddsHint: The Unterkleidung adds its RW to all four locations at once.
Armor.RaHint: How well the location is covered. Comes from the zone's own armour piece; it is what "bypass armour" costs to declare.
Armor.SuitHint: The underclothing layers beneath every zone at once.
Armor.SuitRhZeroHint: Underclothing never grants Armour Hardness — the armour table writes its RH as 0.
Armor.SuitNoRaHint: Underclothing covers no single location — a suit has no RA value.

Small Stuff
Papers and similar odds and ends — items the inventory rules cost at 0 inventory slots. Money is tracked separately in the wallet below.
They take up no slot, so they sit beside the grid rather than in it. The character is still carrying them, and they can be opened and re-sorted like anything else.
